product: Private Client Knowledge and Document Assistant for MSPs
authorization: Server authenticates actor and resolves tenant/document grants. No tenant or role supplied by model is authoritative. Admin has no implicit document-read or business-approval access.
tasks: Find service coverage and exclusions with citations
Answer procedures from SOP with citations
Prepare sourced checklist for human review and verified Odoo activity save

documents.scan_limitations: Machine-printed Latin text; no handwriting, password-protected PDFs or guaranteed recovery from illegible scans. Poor scans enter review.
documents.versions: Immutable content hash and document version; effective/expiry dates explicit; overlapping conflicting active versions require review.

stop_conditions: Unexpected network egress during offline acceptance
resource_budget.embedding_profile: config/embedding-profile.json: separate provisional CPU embedding budget; six-GiB load gate applies to generative LLM, not every model

model_selection: Not selected. Evaluate a single small quantized Ollama model against the frozen rubric after provisioning and resource checks; being runnable is insufficient.

integration.odoo: Reuse project 02 pinned contract 1.0 through adapter. Its activity targets crm.lead opportunity_id, not arbitrary customer/task. Phase 4 must verify tenant-scoped customer-to-opportunity mapping and checklist/source serialization without truncation before accepting adapter.
phase7_pending: Final Linux/container offline egress, cold start, recovery and performance

assumptions: Synthetic clients only; no customer credentials or real documents needed
English UI, English and Indonesian document fixtures
Resource budget is provisional until native measurements; preserve quality gates if runtime must change
